headline.caveat: >$500B combined target across all six financiers, subject to final agreements; no per-firm allocation disclosed

nature_md: Apollo is one of six financiers (with BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR) in NVIDIA's Aug 10, 2026 coalition to establish AI-compute-infrastructure financing platforms mobilizing >$500B of third-party capital, via SPV-issued debt collateralized by NVIDIA compute. Apollo brings the deepest GPU-collateral track record of the six — it co-led the ~$12.5B debt tranche of the xAI GPU SPV. Per-firm commitments are not disclosed and all agreements are memorandums of understanding.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Prospective deployment of client capital (private credit funds, Athene insurance balance sheets) into compute-collateralized SPV debt/equity — fee-earning AUM for Apollo, not principal commitments of Apollo Global Management itself; nothing is booked at MOU stage.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Target capitalization for platforms that do not yet exist as funded entities; the >$500B figure is an aspiration pending final agreements.
